items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I remembered Ernie. ... Because Ernie was a helluva trumpet player. When I heard him he was doing that shit in B-flat... I said, 'Goddamn, he really learned something since I seen him.'

ctx.x: Yeah! Ha-ha-ha. Yeah, I'm going to tell him you said that. But he was; he was older. Ernie got along and Frank Wess and I got along, but Marshall and I didn't seem to hit it off, for some strange reason.
